Author: Bauer, Granziera
Journal: Private Debt and Financial Stability Risks
list_of_vars: Output, house prices, debt-to-GDP ratio, inflation, interest rate
comment: Rather than estimating a panel VAR model that assumes countries are similar enoughto pool their credit cycles, we estimate individual country VARs and pool the individual impulse responses.; house prices are expressed in percentage deviation from the trend calculated using a one-sided HP filter.
